mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when designing an exterior lighting plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: When designing an exterior lighting plan, consider the architectural style of your home, existing landscaping, and the primary purpose of the lighting. Think about areas you want to highlight, pathways that need illumination for safety, and potential security vulnerabilities. Hometelligent Inc. considers light placement to avoid light pollution and glare, ensuring the design enhances your property without negatively impacting neighbors. A well-designed plan balances aesthetics with functionality and energy efficiency, often incorporating dimmers and smart controls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider your home's architecture, landscaping, and lighting purpose. Focus on highlighting features, safety, and security. We also plan to avoid light pollution and glare.
